[b][color=#ead1dc][size=5] 🥲 Background 🥲 [/size][/color]

I'm not a pixel artist 🥲. I tried my best. I just really love One Piece and wanted to have some One Piece inspired things in Stardew Valley.[/b]
[b] If you think my sprites are garbage and want to help me edit some of them, feel free to message me. If you like my mod, leave me a comment, it makes me happy![/b][/center]

[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]How to install:[/size][/color][/b][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#ffd966]How to uninstall:[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]Just delete the [CP] Kimi's One Piece Collection folder from your Stardew Valley mod folder[/center]


[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]How to update:[/color][/b][/size][/center]
